study.source: TRAF-80 registry entry and TRAF-79 mechanism record
study.chronology: Committed before the aligned mechanism implementation, the first aligned simulation run, generated result values, or outcome-dependent edits.

compatibility.selection: Explicit compatibility authority for every inherited consumer.
compatibility.ownership: The compatibility ledger is the sole mutable packet and timing authority when selected.

aligned.selection: Explicit aligned authority for the TRAF-80 sanity study and future opt-in consumers.
aligned.ownership: The aligned receiver-buffer, link-reliability, ordering and switch ledgers are the sole mutable authorities when selected.

authority.mutual_exclusion: One run selects exactly one authority. Compatibility and aligned ledgers never advance the same packet.

declared_candidate_defaults.provenance: TRAF-79 public evidence leaves the product quantum unidentified; the merged 272-byte value is retained only as a compatibility candidate.

declared_candidate_defaults.provenance: TRAF-79 confirms multiple protocol-family virtual channels but publishes no A100 count or map.

TRAF-79 confirms ganged-link spraying but not the A100 selector or granularity.
TRAF-79 supports a policy seam and two-sided matching but binds no algorithm to a named product.

packet_format.default_provenance: The 16-byte family flit is public. The A100 field continuity and selection of optional flits remain declared candidates.

physical_oracles.rate_scaling: Halving every physical link rate doubles the link serialization term exactly.
physical_oracles.credit_ownership: Every credit release timestamp is greater than or equal to its receiver-buffer release timestamp.

sanity_sweep.fixed_job: one 1048576-byte posted peer write from endpoint 0 to endpoint 1
relations: The measured job completion time lies at or above bytes over aggregate link rate.
The measured job completion time lies at or below fully serialized link, endpoint-egress and receiver-ingress service.
The 18-flit link serialization term exceeds the 17-flit term by exactly 5.882352941176471 percent at each rate.
Halving link rate doubles each link serialization term exactly.
The optional flit produces a nonnegative job-completion-time shift at each rate.

preservation_lock_rule.rule: The runner expands every preservation artifact reachable from these frozen roots and verifies its byte digest without executing or rewriting a prior study.

fatal_guards: the expectations digest or final expectations-only commit is not the run authority
either authority advances an object owned by the other authority
the profile-absent service fails to return the exact input object
the compatibility authority changes any canonical result byte
the NV4 pass-through switch changes a packet tuple, timestamp, wire byte, random-draw count or completion order
any root consumer pin or recursively inherited preservation artifact changes
a logical byte, payload flit, control flit, wire byte, acknowledgement or replay is lost or duplicated
a credit is released before its owning receive buffer is released
error-free replay adds any byte or picosecond
an injected error adds a negative byte or time quantity
a packet lacks explicit traffic-class, virtual-channel or ordering-domain identity
consumer visibility violates the frozen per-domain packet sequence
an NVSwitch grant uses one input or output more than once in one grant interval
the identity arbitration seam changes any accepted timestamp, wire byte, random draw or completion order
a repeated-packet payload rate exceeds its applicable physical ceiling
a sanity job completion falls outside its frozen physical floor and ceiling
a prior consumer record, runner, report or figure is rewritten
void_rule: Any fatal-guard violation makes the entire result VOID. No behavioral fraction is reported, TRAF-80 remains open, and no inherited envelope shift is published as valid.
